iptv.xtream_missing: Fill in URL, username and password.
iptv.help: Channels are loaded here and saved into the course. Students see the list and a video player. Works best with .m3u8 (HLS) channels.

type_desc.pdf: Shows a PDF from your PC.
type_desc.webview: A web page opened inside the course.
type_desc.external: Opens a site in the student's browser.
type_desc.local_video: A video stored on your PC.
type_desc.local_audio: An audio track from your PC.
type_desc.download: The student saves the file to their PC.
type_desc.article: Plain text with headings and lists.
type_desc.local_web: Import a page or website from your PC.

content.type_pick_hint: Choose what this button will open:

local_web.label: Import HTML / PHP file
local_web.include_directory: Also copy this file’s folder, including its resources
local_web.directory_help: Use a folder prepared only for this website. Its files and subfolders will be included in the distributed product. Do not choose folders containing private data.
local_web.snapshot_help: A copy is saved. To update files or change the included resources, choose the main file again.
local_web.php_help: PHP requires the PHP runtime bundled with the product. PHP scripts execute code with the user’s permissions: import trusted code only. HTML, CSS and JavaScript work without PHP.
local_web.pick_first: Choose the main HTML or PHP file first.

export.icon_help: Accepts .png, .jpg or .ico. It is automatically converted and applied to the final .exe icon. (GIF is not supported — Windows icons are static.)
export.build_help: Creates a single ready-to-ship .exe. The student double-clicks and the course opens instantly — nothing to install. Can take 30s to 1 min to generate.
